title: DayPage account tag import snapshot v1
description: One immutable import receipt as read through authenticated PostgREST: memo_tag_imports?select=version,source_sha256,payload_hash,payload,created_at (owner-scoped by RLS). Native download/apply is a later batch; no existing native client reads these snapshots yet. payload_hash is the OPAQUE server-side immutable-import fingerprint computed as encode(sha256(convert_to(payload::text,'UTF8')),'hex') over PostgreSQL jsonb::text: it is NOT a portable wire-JSON digest and consumers must not recompute or compare it against a Swift/JS JSON serialization hash. Future cross-client acceptance compares the full logical labels and per-memo associations against the source manifest. created_at accepts PostgREST's native timestamp output, including offsets and up to microsecond precision, without JS millisecond truncation.

version.description: Snapshot schema version carried by the memo_tag_imports.version column (CHECK(version=1)); clients never guess or map it.
